name: play
description: The play control of a recording: a --tap square with --r radius, keylined in --block, the recording's one tone. Turns to a pause glyph while playing (the recorder runtime swaps the glyph).

label.description: The accessible name (aria-label), for example 'Play recording'.

states.active: yes: pressed 1px down, and scaled .97 under the shell's motion
states.disabled: n/a: a recording can always be played
states.selected: n/a: playing is shown by the glyph, not a state
states.loading: n/a: playback starts at once; there is no buffering state
states.error: n/a: the row says when there is no audio
states.empty: n/a: a row with no audio says so in its text; the control is the same

a11y.keyboard: Tab to it, Space or Enter

hooks.data-prototype-recording-id: The prototype's recording id on a memo's play control; the runtime writes it and reads it on a press.
